metadata.note: Miniature stand-in for the Hub's model.safetensors.index.json, shaped so a plausible wrong mapper fails. Layer 0 is split across shards 1 AND 2 (a first-shard-per-layer lookup misses half of it), layer 1 lives wholly in shard 3 (a first-K-shards guess is wrong in both directions), shard 4 holds only a far-future layer and a vision tensor (an implementation that returns every shard, or every non-layer tensor, passes nothing), and shard 5 holds the final norm and output AttnRes tensors apart from the embedding and head (a mapper that follows only embed and head misses it).
